title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta4

## Remaining active-session History hot-path fix

This beta follows the additional field evidence in issue #406 after 0.4.6-beta3.

Beta3 removed full card-trail materialization from MQTT/coordinator updates. The later report identified another large-session cost: several refresh paths still accessed `history.active_session`, whose compatibility accessor deep-copies the complete active session including every retained route point.

With very large retained sessions, that could still make normal refresh work proportional to the full route size even when the caller needed only cycle/task metadata.

### Metadata-only active-session reads

Normal coordinator, ZoneLedger, Schedule and Smart Resume decisions now use a point-light active-session metadata snapshot. The dense `points` array is not copied for those decisions.

The complete `active_session` compatibility accessor remains available for explicit on-demand consumers that really need full route data.

### Incremental VendorTrailStore live-tail reads

VendorTrailStore no longer receives a full copied active session on every normal refresh. History now supplies only points newer than the already-consumed `last_stamp`.

This keeps the recurring live-tail update cost tied to newly arrived samples instead of the total retained session length. No point cap or route truncation is introduced.

Background/on-demand compatibility paths can still request complete route data when needed.

### New performance diagnostics

Home Assistant Download diagnostics now include privacy-safe active-session performance statistics:

- current active raw point count;
- metadata-read count, last/max/average duration;
- incremental tail-read count, last/max/average duration;
- last/max number of copied tail points;
- tail-read point throughput for the latest read;
- full active-session copy count, last/max/average duration and copied point count.

The diagnostics expose counts and timing only. Route geometry is not exported.

Existing beta3 diagnostics remain available:

- coordinator MQTT ingest count/last/max duration;
- card-trail materialization count/last/max duration.

### Compatibility

- No History samples are dropped or capped.
- No mower, Schedule, Resume, Gate or zone semantics are intentionally changed.
- Legacy Map API full-trail compatibility remains available.
- Navimower Map Card 0.3.7 remains compatible.
